overview.description: The Innovator Equity Defined Protection ETF - 1 Yr July (ZJUL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund seeks to track the return of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY), to a cap, with 100% downside hedge over a one-year outcome period. The actively managed fund holds FLEX options to obtain exposure ZJUL was launched on Jun 30, 2024 and is issued by Innovator.

data.title: New Stock ETFs Offer 100% Price Protection. This Is the Big Risk.
data.text: Such 100% buffer ETFs weren't viable when interest rates were close to zero. But with Treasuries yielding about 5% today, you can get a 10% maximum upside cap rate with zero downside.
